label: D2 after choosing a2 when the previous trial was rewarded (early-mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO) and essentially only when this trial s choice was a2 (in_action == 2 at D2; 58592/58607 active steps). Within that, it needs the previous trial to have been rewarded (97% of mass) and is confined to the first ~70 trials of an episode (zero activity after trial 80; peaks trials 10-40), so it carries a slow within-episode time signal. Magnitude grows along runs of rewarded a2 choices (largest on S2-common, rewarded streaks with high value and strongly a2 policy logit; 79% of mass in the top value bin) and is weak on rare transitions to S1 (S1 reached: 8% of mass). Does not fire after a1 choices, at D1/GO, or (much) after unrewarded trials. Predicate uses only observed variables (this trial s choice, observed at D2, previous reward, episode position). Precision is limited: many a2/rewarded D2 steps stay silent, especially in episodes where S1 started good, consistent with a value / a2-streak magnitude code; adding value > 7.7 raised F1 only to 0.718 on dev.
